label: Competitive Win/Loss Deep Dive
description: Conducts systematic analysis of competitive deal outcomes. Identifies competitive patterns, differentiators, and positioning gaps through structured win/loss review methodology.

claudeKnowledge.description: Competitor public information, industry positioning, analyst reports

guidedInputs.label: Key competitors to analyse
guidedInputs.placeholder: List the main competitors you encounter in deals. Include any known positioning or claims they make.

guidedInputs.label: Deal outcome data
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe competitive deals (wins and losses) in as much detail as you have:
- Who won, who lost
- Deal size and type
- What factors were decisive
- What the customer said about the competitor
- What the competitor said about us
- Win rate trends by competitor

guidedInputs.label: Market segment and typical buyer
guidedInputs.placeholder: Who are your typical buyers? Industry, size, geography, buyer role? What problems are they solving?

guidedInputs.label: Our current positioning and value proposition
guidedInputs.placeholder: How do you currently position yourself? What value proposition do you lead with? What are your stated differentiators?

guidedInputs.label: Specific strategic question
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Why do we keep losing to Deloitte on large bank engagements? How should we position against boutique competitors? Where is our competitive moat strongest?
